provenance_policy: Every entry below is from a published, legally shareable primary source. None of these records constitutes an OpenLine field trial or measured OpenLine water saving.
documented_public_data_gap: No publicly licensed dataset currently provides synchronized hourly or sub-hourly data-center IT server power, liquid-cooling CDU temperatures/flows, and cooling-tower makeup/blowdown meter volumes from a live production AI data center.
